workspaces.title: Feature centre
workspaces.launcher.aria: Open the feature centre: eight features, eight pages
workspaces.overview.title: Feature centre
workspaces.overview.subtitle: Every feature gets its own page instead of sharing one crowded panel.
workspaces.overview.lead: One page per feature, ready to use the moment you open it
workspaces.overview.note: This page only routes and hosts controls. Data, verdicts and export provenance stay with their original implementations; there is no second copy of the logic.
workspaces.overview.hint: Pick a feature to open its own page. The address bar remembers the page, so a link can be bookmarked or shared.
workspaces.feature.rollback.title: Intervention rollback
workspaces.feature.rollback.desc: Read the plan first, see dependencies and blockers, then decide whether to execute.
workspaces.feature.confidence.title: Confidence view
workspaces.feature.confidence.desc: Inspect confidence bands per record and filter low or missing values.
workspaces.feature.evidence.title: Causal evidence chain
workspaces.feature.evidence.desc: Attach evidence to a record, and review existing evidence and causal explanations.
workspaces.feature.groups.title: Multi-agent aggregation
workspaces.feature.groups.desc: Create task groups and review members and aggregated results.
workspaces.feature.collab.title: Sharing and collaboration
workspaces.feature.collab.desc: Share records and review grants and revocations.
workspaces.feature.analytics.title: Team lead dashboard
workspaces.feature.analytics.desc: Aggregate intervention, rollback and compliance metrics, and export them.
workspaces.feature.suggestions.title: Automation suggestions
workspaces.feature.suggestions.desc: Turn intervention history into actionable automation suggestions.
workspaces.feature.compliance.title: Compliance audit export
workspaces.feature.compliance.desc: Export a verifiable audit bundle carrying the hash chain and certificate.
workspaces.identity.title: Identity and signatures
workspaces.identity.desc: Who did what under which permission is recorded and signed by the secretariat ledger. These pages do not replace it.
workspaces.rollback.intro: Rollback is irreversible, so it is read twice: the plan first, then an explicit confirmation.
workspaces.rollback.plan.hint: The plan lists the dependency closure and any blockers; nothing changes until you confirm.
workspaces.confidence.intro: Confidence comes from the record's own verdict. This page only bands and filters it; it never re-estimates.
workspaces.confidence.filter.label: Filter
workspaces.evidence.intro: Evidence belongs to a record. You can attach new evidence here and check the existing set.
workspaces.evidence.upload.title: Attach evidence
workspaces.evidence.upload.hint: Submit a before/after diff; the server fingerprints it and writes it into the audit chain.
workspaces.evidence.upload.caption: Note (optional)
workspaces.record.missing: That record is no longer in the current list; it may have been refreshed away.
workspaces.compliance.intro: This page mounts the audit export panel itself, so these buttons are exactly equivalent to the ones in the audit rail.
workspaces.compliance.shared: Below is the audit export panel itself, not a copy of it.
workspaces.state.denied: This identity does not hold that permission.
workspaces.state.permission_write: This identity has no write permission.
workspaces.state.empty_records: No records yet. Run a task through the agent first.
workspaces.state.unavailable: A required module is not loaded.
workspaces.state.error: The action failed. Please try again.
